name: GridScan-TS-TW
title: Grid Scan
description: A perspective grid room drawn in thin pink lines, with a black void at the far end. The whole space leans and skews toward the pointer, and a bright band repeatedly travels down the corridor.
use: A tech or product page wants an immersive depth backdrop that reacts to the pointer.
avoid: You need light backgrounds or heavy text: the scene is near-black with a saturated pink glow.
a11y: Decorative and always animating, with no reduced-motion check and no keyboard counterpart to the pointer tilt. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A one-point perspective box: grid lines run across the floor, walls and ceiling toward a dark rectangle in the middle. Lines are thin and magenta-pink on black, brighter near the centre where the scan light passes.
behaves: The room pivots and skews as the pointer moves, easing back to centre once it leaves. A soft pink band slides along the corridor on a loop, and a click can fire an extra scan that ripples through.
customise: Line colour, thickness, style and jitter, grid scale, scan colour and timing, pointer sensitivity and post effects are props. The room geometry is baked into the shader.
weight: heavy: A full-screen Three.js scene with optional bloom and chromatic aberration renders every frame.
issues: The opening second is almost entirely black until the first scan light crosses the room.
polishWhy: Convincing depth and a well-timed scan; the pink saturates and hides grid detail.
